properties.otherAdvice: The road has been reduced to a single lane in each direction 24/7 until approximately September 2026 for work associated with the M6 Stage 1 project.
Alternating (stop/slow) traffic conditions will be in place to allow motorists to pass in one direction at a time.
A reduced speed limit is in place on Tantangara Rd for safety due to construction work associated with Snowy 2.0.

There is no access to Jenolan Caves.

A section of Jenolan Caves Rd remains closed.

A reduced load limit on Hampden Bridge has been introduced, effective from Friday 27 June 2025.

Heavy vehicles over 23 tonnes are restricted from using the bridge and will need to plan a suitable detour.

All other vehicles will not be affected and can continue to use the bridge.

Emergency services vehicles over 23 tonnes will still be able to use the bridge at all times.

Heavy Vehicle operators of Class 1,2, and 3 vehicles travelling under notice must consult their relevant enforceable network map to confirm a suitable and approved detour route.
There is road damage approximately 15km west of Cryon and 4km east of Cryon due to recent flooding.

A temporary pedestrian bridge will be built across Macquarie St to facilitate the safe movement of participants for the Sydney Marathon event on the weekend of 30-31 August.

Macquarie St will be closed between Bridge St and Bent St to allow for the installation and then removal of the temporary bridge. Once installed the bridge will have a height clearance of 5.2m.

Overnight full and/or lane closures will be in place at the following times:

  • Fri 22 Aug: Full closure from 11pm - 7am
  • Sat 23 Aug: One of two lanes will be closed in both directions from 11pm – 7am
  • Sun 31 Aug: Full closure from 6pm – 4am
  • Mon 1 Sep: Northbound lanes will be closed from 10pm - 2am

When full closures are in place motorists will be detoured via Bridge St, Phillip St and Bent St.

Some parking spaces will be removed from Macquarie St during bridge installation and removal.
